detail.title: CP-UVS-G24R-J
features: Standard dual controller for hardware redundancy
Supports video stream/ Picture direct storage mode and   IPSAN storage mode
Supports video stream/ Picture direct storage mode and  IPSAN storage mode
SAS cascade for expanded storage space

General.HDD Interface: 24 slots, SATA; SAS Max.20 TB/HDD hot swapping CMR support enterprise-grade HDD
General.Record Management: Supports record control (continuous, event-based, scheduled, scheduled & event-based)
General.Thermal Camera Compatibility: Works with camera for fire alarm, temperature alarm, temperature difference alarm, hot spot,  cold spot, smoking and calling
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, face recognition, IVS (abandoned object, missing object, loitering, crowd gath ering, parking, fence-crossing, fast moving, tripwire and intrusion), video metadata (human,  vehicle, non-motor vehicle), vehicle recognition, people counting (fisheye or people counting  camera required), face & body detection, crowd distribution, smart thermal (call detection,  visible channel- smoking detection, thermal channel-smoking detection)
General.People Counting: Works with camera for tripwire people counting, regional people counting and queue people  counting
General.Video Direct Storage (Private Protocol): Incoming: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Recording:256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Outgoing: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512Mbps)   Playback: 16-channel (bandwidth: 32Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Onvif): Incoming: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Recording: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Outgoing: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Playback: 16-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Auto Connect): Incoming: 256channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Recording:256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Outgoing: 256-channel (bandwidth: 512 Mbps)   Playback: 16-channel (bandwidth:32Mbps)
General.Picture Direct Storage: Incoming: 120-channel (550 KB/picture)   Recording:120-channel (550 KB/picture)   Outgoing: 120-channel (550 KB/picture)
General.IPSAN Performance: 180-channel × 2 Mbps video stream writing and 12-channel × 2 Mbps video playback ( I/O size  of VMS is 64 KB)
General.Bullet-PTZ Smart Track: Works with camera for manual tracking, auto tracking, click positioning and select positioning
General.Record Mode: Auto record; manual record; search video detection; IO alarm; thermal imaging; intelligent  event; all record file
General.Browser: Chrome; PCAPP; IE9 or higher; Firefox
General.Network Mode: NIC binding mode such as multiple-address mode, load balance, fault-tolerance, link aggrega tion, etc
General.Playback Function: 1. Play, pause, stop, fast forward, fast backward, reverse play, frame by frame  2. Full-screen, backup (clip; file), snapshot, digital zoom, audio on; off
General.General Alarm: Motion detect; tampering; IPC external alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: IPC offline alarm; storage error; HDD full; video frame loss; SSD exception; IP conflict; MAC  conflict; login lock; fan malfunction; no HDD; network security exception; power exception;  disk health exception; RAID exception; storage pool exception; temperature alarm;   share service
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (full image); alarm uploading; remote device alarm output;  camera audio; buzzer; log; preset; email, smart tracking and warning light.  Disarming alarm linkage action by period or one-click sync disarm config with channels
General.Protocols: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; InstaOn; iSCSI; FTP ;  SMB; NFS; ONVIF (Profile S); CGI; SDK
General.Power Consumption: <120 W (without HDD, idling)  <500 W (all HDDs connected)
